name: ORKIM
recent: Orkim 近期在中国订购两艘成品油轮，并提前接收一艘新船，船队规模扩大至21艘。同时，公司获得税收优惠延长，近期公告主要为雇员公积金局等大股东持股变动。
notable: 在中国订购两艘成品油轮，总价约3760万美元。
提前接收一艘新造油轮，船队规模扩大至21艘。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收8733.5万令吉，环比下降0.8%；净利2290.6万令吉，环比下降5.0%；净利率26.2%，低于上季度的27.4%。

recent_en: Orkim recently ordered two product tankers in China and took early delivery of a new vessel, expanding its fleet to 21 ships. It also secured a tax incentive extension, while recent announcements were mainly changes in substantial shareholders' interests such as EPF.
notable_en: Ordered two product tankers in China for about US$37.6 million.
Took early delivery of a newbuild tanker, expanding the fleet to 21 vessels.
Secured an extension of tax incentives.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR87.335 million, down 0.8% QoQ; net income was MYR22.906 million, down 5.0% QoQ; net margin was 26.2%, lower than 27.4% in the previous quarter.
